runs.text: Parameters are the input variables of a subprogram: on every call they receive a
of the values passed to it.
Every parameter has a name and a required type. In the call, the
are assigned to the parameters in order. Without any mark, passing is
: the parameter is a new variable with a copy of the argument, and changing it does not affect the caller.

blocks.title: The parameter is a copy

blocks.description: On the left, the main frame with x equal to 5. In the first step, Copia receives a box n with a copy that becomes 6 without changing x. In the second, Incrementar receives an arrow to x, which becomes 6.

caption.text: By value, the subprogram gets its own box with a copy. By reference, its parameter is another name for the caller's box.
